mend.name: Mend the Wick
mend.desc: The first prayer every chandler learns: press the warm wax back into the wound and ask the flame to hold.

radiant_blast.name: Radiant Blast
radiant_blast.desc: A thrown coal of remembered daylight. It goes where grief is aimed.

radiant_burst.name: Radiant Burst
radiant_burst.desc: The whole candle at once. Everything near the vigil learns what it was to stand in the kingdom's noon.

morrow_lance.name: Morrow Lance
morrow_lance.desc: A straight seam of morning driven through everything between you and the far wall. The light does not swerve, and does not apologise.

vesper_ward.name: Vesper Ward
vesper_ward.desc: The evening office, worn. A skin of remembered candlelight that takes the world's anger first, and goes out doing it.
